function.name: run_sql
function.arguments:
{"sql":"SELECT period,
       SUM(revenue_cad) AS rev,
       SUM(amount_cad) AS cost,
       SUM(qty) AS qty,
       (SUM(revenue_cad)-SUM(amount_cad))/SUM(qty) AS unit_margin
FROM lightning.metastore.finmozg.finance_usl.sales_line sl
JOIN lightning.metastore.finmozg.finance_usl.purchase_line pl
  ON sl.period = pl.period AND sl.sku = pl.sku
WHERE sl.period IN ('2026-08','2026-09')
GROUP BY period","purpose":"Compute unit margin per period using joined sales and purchase lines (approx)"}
